text: A股三大指数早盘集体上涨，截至午盘，上证指数涨0.08%，深证成指涨0.41%，创业板指涨0.34%，北证50涨1.29%，科创50指数涨0.58%。全市场成交额8843亿元，较上日缩量2861亿元，全市场超4000只个股上涨。板块题材上，电池、元件、文化传媒、房地产、AI视频板块涨幅居前；煤炭开采加工、培育钻石、小家电、油气开采及服务、种植业与林业板块跌幅居前。盘面上，电池板块高开高走，尚水智能、国轩高科、时代万恒等股涨停，亿华通、纳科诺尔、利元亨涨幅居前。元件板块表现强势，迅捷兴、超声电子、依顿电子、奥士康涨停，金百泽、金禄电子、强达电路涨幅居前。房
text_en: A-shares' three major indices rose collectively in the morning session. As of the midday close, the Shanghai Composite Index rose 0.08%, the Shenzhen Component Index rose 0.41%, the ChiNext Index rose 0.34%, the BSE 50 rose 1.29%, and the STAR 50 Index rose 0.58%. Total market turnover was 884.3 billion yuan, down 286.1 billion yuan from the previous day, and more than 4,000 stocks in the whole market rose. By sector theme, battery, components, cultural media, real estate and AI video sectors led gains; coal mining and processing, lab-grown diamonds, small household appliances, oil and gas extraction and services, and planting and forestry sectors led declines. On the board, the battery sector opened high and moved higher, with Shangshui Intelligent, Gotion High-Tech, Shidai Wanheng and other stocks hitting the daily limit, while SinoHytec, Naknor and Liyuanheng led gains. The components sector performed strongly, with Xunjiexing, Chaozhou Three-Circle, Yidun Electronics and Aoshikang hitting the daily limit, while Jinbaize, Jinlu Electronics and Qiangda Circuit led gains.
